text:
I think I should start writing the next comic.
It'll be our first time doing My Adventures with Superman... and you'll see who Clark Kent ends up with.
Sung Jin-Woo has your dessert ready. It's nice being with him.
And so Cabba's intense training continues. I wonder what Vegeta will teach him next.

Our dear Nakamura can't stop thinking about what Hirose would do.
That panel comes from one of our comics 🤭

You have no choice but to kneel before the great Bakugo!
Though you have to admit, the view is pretty nice.

Hope you liked all the August characters. There are even more than the ones shown in this image.
There's also a comic starring the Blue Lock characters!

This is how Rudeus apologizes to his dad after their fight.
Life without Paul Greyrat just isn't the same, I miss him 😭
There's no doubt Trunks inherited his looks from Bulma and Vegeta. And I prefer him with long hair!
This is how Reo lets Isagi know that Nagi's Decision comic is out! 😉
Wrapping up August with Yuta Okkotsu! Looks like he wants you to pay attention to his feet.
